description: Draft a hosted giveaway: prize, dates, draw, entry page, bonus entries and official rules. It starts as a draft with a preview link. A signed-in person approves it at dashboardUrl before it goes live; send them that link.

brandId.description: Brand ID, the project that runs the giveaway.

closesAt.description: When entries close, as an ISO 8601 time. Must be after opensAt.

drawMethod.description: single: one winner. multiple: equal winners. placed: 1st, 2nd, 3rd…

entryPage.description: The hosted entry page's headline, description, image, brand color and bonuses.

url.description: Where the follow or visit action sends people.

bonusActions.description: Bonus entries on offer: referral, share, follow and visit. Pro and up.

language.description: The language entrants see: en or es. Left out, the language of the brand's country, else en.

name.description: The giveaway's name, shown as its title.

opensAt.description: When entries open, as an ISO 8601 time.

prizes.description: One prize per place for placed draws; otherwise the first prize goes to every winner.

perkId.description: A perk from this brand to give the winner of this place.

rules.description: The official rules. sponsorCountry and countries default to the brand's own country. A person approves them before the giveaway goes live.

fields.description: The official rules generator's operator fields: sponsor, eligibility and so on.

timezone.description: The time zone the official rules and dashboard use, e.g. Europe/London. Left out, the brand's own: from its site's country domain, then its saved zone.

name: create_giveaway
title: Create a giveaway
